IC1: - Male [OR] or female > 18 [AND] and < 60 years of age, Body Mass Index (BMI) <40.
IC2: - Generally in good health as determined by the Principal Investigator based on prior medical history, American Society of Anesthesiologists physical status I or II
IC3: - Normal blood pressure (systolic 90-140 mmHg; diastolic 50-90 mmHg) resting heart rate
IC5: - Female subjects of child-bearing potential [AND] and those < 1 year post-menopausal, must be practicing highly effective methods of birth control such as hormonal methods
